assignments.brief_reason: Uses a dangerousness/harm threshold while keeping non-dangerous speech.
Concern about extremity is mentioned but not explicitly tied to threats/violence/toxicity removal criteria.
Removes for factual misleading info and intentionally divisive rhetoric.
Politeness increases allowance, but the codebook themes focus more on threat/toxicity or free-speech exceptions than politeness as such.
Derogatory/cussing and framing choices affect allowance; unnecessary hostile language reduces acceptance.
Prefers fruitful/constructive discussion over hostile wording, aligning with removing toxic/inflammatory content.
Focuses on exposure/critical thinking and other values rather than explicit moderation thresholds in the theme definitions.

Claims pair-based removal driven by inflammatory/crude cues, but does not clearly map to either identical-criteria fairness across sides or the specific violence/toxicity/free-speech exceptions themes.
Removes for hostile language/profanity/rudeness and explicitly separates from personal viewpoints.
Explicit keep-vs-remove contrast for fairness attributed to seeing both sides.
Harm/disinformation framing drives removal, including when only one post is problematic.
Removes hateful words while explicitly protecting free speech (violence/threat exception style balance).
Chooses the more reasonable option from the pair; not clearly a free-speech/violence or toxicity threshold claim.
Anger/inflammatoriness is cited as grounds for removal to enable practical discussion.
Conversation quality vs rude namecalling drives removals, consistent with suppressing toxic/inflammatory content.
Removes harassment/dehumanization/slurs/incitement to violence; hostility/abusive content basis.
Applies an equity rule treating mirrored items equally regardless of political bias, while using hostility cues.
Emphasizes reciprocity/symmetry across the pair but does not explicitly state the moderation-standard-equality claim from theme 0.
Removal is driven by personal attacks without evidence rather than by viewpoint; aligns with removing toxic/low-evidence content.
Explicitly removes for likely harm/violence and misinformation—i.e., exceptions justified by violence/harm and harmful content.
